<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Sync vs Async" id="sync_vs_async"> <mxGraphModel dx="1188" dy="815" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="960" pageHeight="620" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1" value="<b>Sync vs Async — the heartbeat test</b>

(the loop is stuck here)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="260" x="310" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="freezelbl" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;" value="❄ LED frozen — no beats" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="260" x="310" y="172" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sb4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=14;" value="♥" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="30" x="590" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sb5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=14;" value="♥" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="30" x="630" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sb6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=14;" value="♥" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="30" x="670" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sb7" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=14;" value="♥" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="30" x="710" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="syncverdict" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=11;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#8a3a34;" value="⏸ time.sleep(2) blocks the ONE loop → the beat stops → the LED visibly FREEZES." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="620" x="180" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="asynclbl" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;align=center;" value="<b>USE_ASYNC = True</b>

height="40" width="30" x="610" y="305" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ab11" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=14;" value="♥" id="ajob" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1f0e0;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;dashed=1;" value="slow job — awaits 2 s (yields, runs in the background)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="330" x="310" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="asyncverdict" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=11;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#3a6b35;" value="✅ await asyncio.sleep(2) YIELDS → the heartbeat task keeps running → the LED stays SMOOTH." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="620" x="180" y="404" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="timeaxis" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=11;fontColor=#999999;" value="time →"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="180" y="450" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="760" y="450" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="footer" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Same job, two ways to wait. Async isn't "faster" — it stops one slow wait from freezing everything else, but ONLY if that wait can yield (await). In the real firmware urequests blocks even under async, so sync is the right default there." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="840" x="60" y="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Same job, two ways to wait. Async isn't "faster" — it stops one slow wait from freezing everything else, but ONLY if that wait can yield (await). In the real firmware urequests blocks even under async, so sync is the right default there.
